text: I must clarify that the symptoms you described—jaundice, yellowish skin starting on the face and spreading, and scleral icterus—are characteristic of newborn hyperbilirubinemia, not acute appendicitis, which is a condition of the abdomen causing severe pain and fever, not skin discoloration.
